question:
The given line graph shows the number of scooters manufactured (in thousands) by companies X and Z, over the years. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afbfbb5cfa9eebdf6dc8bf04aeeeb35ea6eaecd703ea485edd9fec149b82c40e.png] 

What is the approximate difference between the total production by companies X and Z in the given years?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The total production by companies X = 128000 + 110000 + 102000 + 80000 + 109000 + 170000

⇒ 699000

The total production by companies Y = 141000 + 192000 + 145000 + 130000 + 122000 + 161000

⇒ 891000

The approximate difference between the total production by companies X and Z in the given years

⇒ 891000 - 699000

⇒ 192000 

**∴ The approximate difference between the total production by companies X and Z in the given years is 192000.**
